bio.text: According to the Aguilar campaign website, Cesar Aguilar is a current state representative for District 26 who was born and raised in Phoenix.

The site says Aguilar graduated from Northern Arizona University with a bachelor's degree in political science in 2016, worked for the Arizona Democratic Party, and now works for the nonprofit Arizona Students' Association on college accessibility and affordability.
It also says Aguilar has served on multiple governing boards advocating for Latino children in K-12 and higher education.
